sections.heading: Variants
sections.text: Sag mir Bescheid! :: Let me know! Danke, dass Sie Bescheid sagen. :: Thank you for letting me know. Wer keine Zeit hat, sagt mir bitte bis Montag Bescheid. :: Whoever has no time, please let me know by Monday.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text: When you promise to tell someone later, or thank someone for telling you. The person is in the Dativ: mir , dir , Ihnen .
